# Navigation/Link directive

Styled native anchor; preserves browser navigation and modified clicks.

## Identity

- Class: `LinkDirective`
- Selector: `a[dlLink]`
- Kind: standalone directive
- [Component source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/navigation/link.directive.ts)
- [Storybook source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/navigation/link.stories.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Import the standalone LinkDirective from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
- Use `appearance` for per-instance presentation and `styleTokens` for theme tokens. Preserve the shared light and black/glass themes; use the library stylesheet.
- Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
- Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

## Configuration coverage

- `appearance`: [Appearance](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-link-directive-appearance--appearance) — Overrides multiple visual properties for this instance.
- `styleTokens`: [StyleTokens](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-link-directive-appearance--style-tokens) — Overrides CSS theme tokens for this instance and its descendants.
- `href`: [Href](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-link-directive-configuration--href) — Sets the native link destination. Here it is set to “#link-destination”.
- `target`: [TargetSelf](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-link-directive-configuration--target-self) — Chooses which browsing context opens the destination. Here it is set to “_self”.
- `target`: [TargetBlank](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-link-directive-configuration--target-blank) — Chooses which browsing context opens the destination. Here it is set to “_blank”.

- `target`: [TargetTop](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-link-directive-configuration--target-top) — Chooses which browsing context opens the destination. Here it is set to “_top”.
- `rel`: [Rel](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-link-directive-configuration--rel) — Configures the relationship to the linked destination; new-tab links also include noopener. Here it is set to “nofollow”.
